title: Sovyn Alternatives for Paid Social Video Ads, Compared for 2026
summary: Sovyn alternatives for paid video ads: Knowlify first, then managed studios, a low-cost subscription and a growth agency, prices checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
Knowlify is our top pick for a team that needs paid video ads made and delivered, not another agency to brief. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. Sōvyn is a different kind of company. Its website describes a healthcare marketing and PR agency that works exclusively in healthcare, health tech, biotech, life sciences and dental tech, so the right alternative depends on which part of that engagement you are replacing.


## What does Sōvyn sell, and what does its site leave out?


Sōvyn's homepage, checked October 2026, lists public relations, marketing and lead gen, strategy, content creation, branding, professional video, web design, GEO and AI search, conferences and events, scientific platforms, fractional CMO work, market research and workshops.[sovyn.com](https://sovyn.com/) The page describes services rather than a software product for buyers to run themselves. Those services sit under one roof, so a "Sovyn alternative" can mean several different purchases, and a PR firm and a paid video studio do not replace each other.


The page lists no prices and calls its programs custom. It publishes case-study results, including one filed under digital advertising, but its service list does not name paid ads as a standalone product. Before you compare, ask for a written scope and quote for each service you buy, and confirm whether the "professional video" it offers means paid ads or brand content.


## Which alternative replaces which part of the job?


The table below lists published terms as of October 2026, with Knowlify first.


Option Published starting point What it covers Use it when


Knowlify From $5,000 a month Finished AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, about 25 a week, with optional Meta campaign management You need paid video output, not PR


Creatify Studio $100 to $200 per video in its comparison table Managed AI video production, 25 to 100 or more videos a month You want a managed studio and will run the ads yourself


CreatStrat $299 a month for 5 ads a week Statics, carousels, AI video and AI UGC, cancel anytime Your budget is small and the ad count is fixed


NoGood Average monthly retainer above $20,000 Paid social across several channels, with static, motion and UGC creative You want a growth team and healthcare is on its industry list


Superside $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term, plus a $1,000 monthly software fee Ad creative, design, video and motion for a broad queue You have a large creative queue and an annual budget


The sources we checked for these options do not describe PR as a service, so pair one with a communications firm if you still need that work.


## Knowlify: our top pick for finished paid video ads


Knowlify is the best fit when the part of the Sōvyn engagement you want to replace is paid video. It makes about 25 finished Facebook and Instagram ads a week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery. That cadence gives a health tech, dental or life sciences brand enough variety to test a presenter, an animated explainer and a product scene without hiring three vendors.


It works in three formats: AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation and AI commercials. You can take creative only, or add end-to-end Meta campaign management. Pricing is a custom quote. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund, with the terms on the site (see[pricing and guarantee](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). Knowlify (YC S25) was founded in 2025 and is based in San Francisco. Our[video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) page covers the scope in more detail.


When to pick another option: Knowlify does not list PR, web design, events or search optimization among its services, and it does not run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads.


### Creatify Studio: a managed studio with a strategist


Creatify's Studio page describes an assigned creative strategist, a team that uses AI to write hooks and scripts, and AI plus human QA on every asset. It lists 25 to 100 or more videos a month on a 48-hour turnaround, as of October 2026.[creatify.ai/studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) Its comparison table puts Studio at $100 to $200 per video. The page does not say whether Studio runs campaigns, so ask that before you compare it with a campaign-managed option. Our[Creatify alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/creatify-alternatives) covers the rest of that field.


### CreatStrat: a subscription for a small, fixed test budget


CreatStrat prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly and cancellable at any time, as of October 2026.[creatstrat.com](https://creatstrat.com/) Its formats are statics, carousels, footage mashups, AI video and AI UGC. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad, so ask both questions before you sign.


### NoGood: a growth team that lists healthcare


NoGood's FAQ lists SaaS, B2B, healthcare, fintech, consumer, ecommerce and AI as its industries, and its homepage says it works exclusively in those sectors.[nogood.io](https://nogood.io/) Its paid social work covers Facebook and Instagram alongside LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit and other platforms. It has no standardized packages and says its average monthly retainer is above $20,000. Choose it if you want strategy and media alongside creative, not a video-only order.
